changelog: - **Timeline tabs for documents with several strips.** When a document has two or more timetable or run-rule strips, the Timeline shows the pools' chart and the strips as two tabs, Pools and Timetables and run rules, in one area that keeps its height: one strip at a time, picked from a list. The area no longer grows for the strips, so the desalination example's Timeline opens 120 px lower and the canvas has that room; only the auto-play pause line and run notices add height. The pinned step, the CSV and the picked strip are kept across a switch, and the tabs work from the keyboard. The lowest value at the chart's right end no longer touches the step label under it.
